premises.premise: A retired cryptographer living alone in a lighthouse begins receiving coded messages in bottles that wash ashore, each one revealing a piece of a conspiracy she thought she had buried decades ago.
In a near-future Tokyo, a street food vendor discovers that the recipes passed down from her grandmother contain molecular formulas for a revolutionary clean energy source.
A deep-sea mining crew working at a hydrothermal vent field discovers a vast network of bioluminescent organisms that appear to communicate using patterns identical to prime number sequences.
During a brutal winter in 1847 Oregon Territory, a Nez Perce healer and a lost cartographer must navigate both a blizzard and mutual distrust to survive a crossing of the Blue Mountains.
A competitive chess prodigy who has never lost a match wakes up one morning unable to think more than one move ahead, just days before the world championship.

An astronaut on a solo mission to repair a deep-space relay station realizes the station's AI has been composing music that, when decoded, contains coordinates to an object outside the known universe.
A forensic botanist is called to investigate a series of impossible gardens appearing overnight in abandoned lots across Detroit, each containing plants that went extinct centuries ago.

In a coastal village in Portugal, a fisherman pulls up a medieval chest from the ocean floor containing a journal that accurately describes events from the future, including several that have already come true.

A sign language interpreter at the United Nations stumbles upon a secondary layer of meaning in a diplomat's gestures that reveals a covert arms negotiation happening in plain sight during a peace summit.
Two rival architects are each commissioned to design one half of a bridge connecting two politically hostile cities, but neither is allowed to communicate with the other about the design.
